name: Ajax Load More – WordPress Infinite Scroll, Search & Filter
author: Akshar Addons

sections.description:
Ajax Load More helps you display WordPress posts in a clean, responsive post grid or post list. Visitors can load additional posts without a full page reload, making it a practical choice for blogs, news sections, homepages, and content archives.

Configure the layout from the widget settings or use the shortcode in a page, post, template, sidebar, or reusable content area. The free version includes responsive templates, post images, category filtering, AJAX loading, and multiple widget instances.

🚀 Key Features

  • ✅ Previous/Next AJAX pagination without a full page refresh.
  • 🧩 Responsive WordPress post grid and post list layouts.
  • 🔎 Category-based post filtering.
  • 🎨 Customizable widget heading text and background colors.
  • 🖼️ Post image display with responsive templates.
  • 📱 Multiple widget instances for sidebars and content areas.
  • 🔗 Shortcode support for pages, posts, templates, and content blocks.

🔗 Product Links

  • Buy Now | Live Demo | Documentation | Support Request

🧩 Shortcode

Add the shortcode to a WordPress Shortcode block, post, page, or template:

[ajaxpostloadmore number_of_post_display="6" template="pane_style_1"]

🎯 Perfect For

  • Blog homepages and content landing pages.
  • News, magazine, and editorial post grids.
  • Category-based post sections.
  • Sidebars and compact content areas.

🔧 How It Works

  1. Edit a page or post.
  2. In Gutenberg, add a Shortcode block. In Elementor or a supported page builder, add a shortcode element.
  3. Paste [ajaxpostloadmore number_of_post_display="6" template="pane_style_1"].
  4. Configure the shortcode attributes and publish the page.
  5. Let visitors load more posts with AJAX.

⭐ Premium Features

Upgrade for advanced post display and pagination controls:

  • ⚡ Load More, Previous/Next, and numeric AJAX pagination buttons.
  • 🧱 Custom post type support.
  • 🧱 Elementor widget and Gutenberg block controls for premium settings.
  • 🔎 Search posts by title from the post display area.
  • 🎨 Additional responsive templates and hover animation effects.
  • 🖼️ Controls for image size, post image, title, excerpt, and read more link.
  • ↕️ Sort posts by post ID or title in ascending or descending order.
  • 👁️ Show or hide categories, post counts, dates, comments, author names, and author images.
  • ↔️ RTL layout support and adjustable spacing between post items.
  • 🔗 Dynamic multiple shortcode creation for content areas.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Edit a page or post and add a Gutenberg Shortcode block, Elementor shortcode element, or supported page builder shortcode element.
  4. Paste [ajaxpostloadmore number_of_post_display="6" template="pane_style_1"].
  5. Configure the post display attributes and publish the page.
sections.faq:
Can I display posts in a grid or list?

Yes. The free version includes responsive post grid and post list layouts.

Does it work without a page reload?

Yes. Additional posts are requested and rendered with AJAX.

Can I use more than one widget?

Yes. Multiple widget instances can be configured for different areas of a site.
